chunks: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Fadhal narrated from al-Abbas ibn Amir, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Mansur ibn Hazim, who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): A man married a woman and did not specify a dowry for her. He said: She has nothing of the dowry. But if he had intercourse with her, then she has the dowir of her equals.

key_terms.دَخَلَ بِهَا: he had intercourse with her (consummation of marriage)
key_terms.مَهرُ نِسَائِهَا: dowry of her equals (mahr al-mithl), a standard amount determined by comparison to similar women

ai.seo_question: What is the dowry entitlement for a wife if no specific amount was agreed upon at marriage?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Isfabar clarifies the default dowry (mahr al-mithl) applicable when no specific amount is stipulated, emphasizing that entitlement arises upon consummation. It reflects the Shia juristic principle that the marriage contract is valid even without a specified mahr, with the amount determined by the woman's social status and family background. The ruling underscores the protection of women's financial rights in the absence of explicit agreement.
